description: Bunny's log of failed requests to a pull zone's origin on one day: why each failed (e.g. http_timeout, http_request_failure, dns_lookup, network_socket_exception). Use it to confirm 502 or 504 errors from Bunny's side. Origin responses with an error status, such as a PHP-FPM 502, may not appear here. Returns counts and samples for one page of up to 200 entries. Which part of the day that page covers varies between calls, so check from and to; hasMoreData means other entries exist that this tool does not fetch.

detail.description: Return the raw entries, including request headers (very large). Default false

name: origin_errors
